name: secure-mcp-platform
description: One-command install of the operator's Business MCP stack with Docker Compose: Postgres 17 (roles ygg_app/ygg_read/nocodb, empty Business schema, schema mcp, ygg_receipts.mac.receipts hash chain), NocoDB, the Business MCP server (stdio via `docker compose exec -T` and Streamable HTTP on 127.0.0.1), and optional Ollama + nomic-embed-text for search (compose profile 'search'). Fresh installs hold NO business rows. Written so an AI with shell + file tools can follow it step by step; steps marked requires_human need the operator.
how_to_follow: Export every input as an environment variable (its `env` name), using the default unless the operator gave a value.
Run steps in order. For each step: if `when` is present, run it first with bash; a non-zero exit means skip the step.
If requires_human is true: show the operator `human_prompt` and wait for an explicit yes before running `run`. Never answer for him.
Run `run` with bash in `cwd` (expand $VARS and ~). Compare with `expect` (exit_code, and output_matches as a regex over stdout+stderr).
Then run `verify.run` and compare with `verify.expect`. On any mismatch stop, read `on_failure`, report, and do not improvise destructive fixes.
After the steps, run every check in `post_install_verification`. Use `uninstall` only when the operator asks.
A reference runner exists: node deploy/scripts/follow-install-guide.mjs INSTALL.json (needs Node >= 22 on the host).
safety: Never print, cat, echo, grep -v, or paste the contents of .env, and never run `docker compose config` without -q (it prints the interpolated secrets). Read only the non-secret keys COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME, COMPOSE_PROFILES, YGG_MCP_TAG and YGG_*_PORT, with: sed -n 's/^KEY=//p' .env.
Never delete Docker volumes (`down -v`, `volume rm`, `--delete-data`) unless the operator explicitly asks for that specific project; it destroys the database.

Never run a bare `docker compose down` from another directory, and always pass the project name (-p) when stopping or removing anything. Never touch other compose projects (for example ygg-scratch or ragnarok-shop).
Never commit or push .env, dumps, or data. The repo .gitignore and .dockerignore exclude them; do not override.
Never `git push`. Commit locally only if the operator asks.
Never modify an existing MCP client registration (for example ygg-business); register-clients.sh refuses existing names.
Do not call any AI/LLM API as part of the install or the checks; nothing here needs one.
Real business data is loaded only by step s10-restore-real-data, with the operator's approval.

prerequisites.what: Docker Engine 24+ via Docker Desktop, OrbStack, or Docker Engine on Linux
prerequisites.install_hint: macOS: install OrbStack (brew install orbstack) or Docker Desktop, then start it. Linux: https://docs.docker.com/engine/install/. Installing software needs the operator's approval.
Bundled with Docker Desktop/OrbStack; on Linux install docker-compose-plugin.
Preinstalled on macOS; Linux: apt install openssl.

prerequisites.what: curl, for the host-side HTTP check
About 3 GB free for images (plus ~0.3 GB for the optional nomic-embed-text model and ~3 GB for the Ollama image)
prerequisites.check: df -Pk "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}" | awk 'NR==2{print int($4/1048576)" GB free"; exit !($4>3145728)}'

prerequisites.what: OPTIONAL: Node >= 22 on the host, only for the offline tests, the reference runner and the host receipts hooks
prerequisites.install_hint: Optional. The container brings its own Node 22.23.3.

inputs.description: Where to clone the source from: a local path or a git URL (the repo has no remote; copy it to the new machine or clone over ssh).
Where the package is installed (the compose project directory).
Compose project name; containers and volumes are prefixed with it. Must not clash with an existing project.
Host port for Postgres, bound to 127.0.0.1.
Host port for NocoDB, bound to 127.0.0.1.
Host port for the MCP Streamable HTTP endpoint (/mcp), bound to 127.0.0.1.
NocoDB super-admin login email (the password is generated into .env).
Tag for the locally built image secure-mcp-platform:<tag>.
1 = also run Ollama + pull nomic-embed-text (profile 'search', several GB). 0 = business_search_items returns an 'embedder unavailable' error; the other 5 tools work.
1 = load 12 made-up DEMO- items so the tools return something. Default keeps the database empty.
Optional path to a pg_dump (custom format) of ygg_business with real data. Empty = skip. the operator must approve.
Name to register in Claude Code. Must not already exist (ygg-business is the operator's existing host registration).
1 = install the optional host-level receipts hooks (zsh + Claude Code) pointed at this DB.

steps.title: Get the source
steps.why: Everything (compose file, Dockerfile, init SQL, scripts) lives in the repo; the install runs from inside it.

diagnosis: Source path/URL wrong or unreachable: check YGG_REPO_SOURCE.
Target exists but is not a git checkout: pick another YGG_REPO_DIR; do not delete the existing folder.
on_failure.rollback: rm -rf "$YGG_REPO_DIR" only if this step created it and the operator agrees.

steps.title: Check prerequisites
steps.why: Fails early, before anything is written, if Docker/Compose/openssl are missing or the daemon is down.

diagnosis: 'docker daemon not reachable': start OrbStack/Docker Desktop.
'docker compose v2 plugin not found': install the compose plugin (needs the operator).
Nothing was changed by this step.

steps.title: the operator approves the install
steps.why: The install pulls about 2 GB of images (postgres:17-alpine, nocodb/nocodb:2026.10.0, node:22.23.3-bookworm-slim), builds an image, and starts 3 long-running containers on 127.0.0.1 ports.
steps.human_prompt: OK to install project $COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME: pull ~2 GB of images and run Postgres on 127.0.0.1:$YGG_PG_PORT, NocoDB on 127.0.0.1:$YGG_NC_PORT and the MCP on 127.0.0.1:$YGG_MCP_HTTP_PORT? (yes/no)

verify.run: for p in $YGG_PG_PORT $YGG_NC_PORT $YGG_MCP_HTTP_PORT; do (exec 3<>/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/$p) 2>/dev/null && { echo "port $p busy"; exit 1; }; done; echo ports free

diagnosis: A port is busy: choose other YGG_*_PORT inputs (ports are fixed into .env at s04).
the operator said no: stop here.

steps.title: Generate secrets into .env
steps.why: Creates random hex passwords for postgres, ygg_app, ygg_read, nocodb and the NocoDB admin, plus the ports and project name, in .env with mode 600. Prints no secret. Refuses to overwrite an existing .env.

verify.run: stat -c %a .env 2>/dev/null || stat -f %Lp .env; sed -n 's/^COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME=//p' .env; git check-ignore -q .env && echo ignored-by-git

diagnosis: .env exists: it holds the passwords baked into the existing volumes; keep it and skip this step.
openssl missing: see prerequisites.
on_failure.rollback: rm .env  (only if no containers/volumes were created yet for this project)

steps.title: Validate the compose file
steps.why: Catches a broken .env or compose file before anything starts. Uses -q / --services so no interpolated secret is printed.
steps.run: docker compose config -q && docker compose config --services | sort | tr '\n' ' '

verify.run: docker compose --profile search config --services | sort | tr '\n' ' '

diagnosis: 'run ./install.sh first': .env is missing keys; re-run s04 in a clean checkout.
Never debug with plain `docker compose config` (prints secrets).

steps.title: Build and start the stack (the one command)
steps.why: ./install.sh reuses .env, builds the MCP image (multi-stage, Node 22.23.3, npm ci, tsc), starts pg -> (initdb: roles, 6 databases, empty Business schema, schema mcp, mac.receipts hash chain) -> nocodb + mcp, waits until healthy, writes one install receipt to the chain, and runs a quick verification.

diagnosis: Image pull failed: network/registry; re-run ./install.sh (idempotent).
pg unhealthy: docker compose logs pg | tail -50 (initdb errors show the failing SQL file).
mcp unhealthy: docker compose logs mcp | tail -50 (missing configuration / DB auth).
Port in use: change YGG_*_PORT in .env before the first successful start.
on_failure.rollback: ./uninstall.sh  (removes containers, keeps volumes and .env). A brand-new install with no data may also be wiped with: YGG_CONFIRM_DELETE=$COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME ./uninstall.sh --delete-data  (ask the operator first).

steps.title: MCP handshake lists the 6 tools (stdio and HTTP)
steps.why: Proves both client paths work: stdio (what Claude Code/Desktop spawn via docker compose exec) and Streamable HTTP on 127.0.0.1.
steps.run: docker compose exec -T mcp node scripts/mcp-check.mjs

verify.run: printf '%s\n' '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"initialize","params":{"protocolVersion":"2025-06-18","capabilities":{},"clientInfo":{"name":"install-guide","version":"1"}}}' '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"notifications/initialized"}' '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":2,"method":"tools/list"}' | docker compose exec -T mcp node dist/index.js 2>/dev/null | grep -o '"name":"business_[a-z_]*"' | sort -u | wc -l | tr -d ' '

diagnosis: FAIL with 'upstream_unavailable' or auth errors: DB URL/password mismatch; .env changed after first boot?
HTTP FAIL only: check docker compose logs mcp.

steps.title: Receipts hash chain verifies intact
steps.why: ygg_receipts.mac.receipts is append-only and hash-chained; mac.verify() recomputes the whole chain (the install receipt from s06 is in it).

diagnosis: 'relation mac.receipts does not exist': initdb did not apply hooks/mac-receipts/sql; check docker compose logs pg | grep 02-schemas.
ok=f: report first_bad_seq to the operator; never try to 'fix' rows (the table is append-only by design).

steps.title: OPTIONAL: load made-up demo data
steps.why: A fresh install is empty. Demo rows (UIDs DEMO-001..012) let you see the tools return data. Not the operator's data; removable.

verify.run: docker compose exec -T mcp node scripts/run-evals.mjs --agree

diagnosis: 'already has N rows': the DB is not empty; demo data is only for empty installs.

steps.title: OPTIONAL: restore the operator's real data from a dump
steps.why: Loads real rows from a pg_dump of ygg_business (data only; the schema already exists). Real data only enters a running database, never the image or repo.
steps.human_prompt: Restore real Business data from $YGG_RESTORE_DUMP into project $COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME? (yes/no)

verify.run: docker compose exec -T mcp node scripts/run-evals.mjs

diagnosis: 'already has N rows': refuse; restore only into an empty install (e.g. load-demo.sh --remove first).
pg_restore errors: the dump's schema differs from deploy/sql/010_business_schema.sql.
on_failure.rollback: Ask the operator. Option: YGG_CONFIRM_DELETE=$COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME ./uninstall.sh --delete-data, then ./install.sh for a clean empty DB.

steps.title: OPTIONAL: semantic search (Ollama + nomic-embed-text)
steps.why: business_search_items needs an embedder. Profile 'search' adds an Ollama container and a one-shot job that pulls nomic-embed-text (~270 MB model, multi-GB image). The MCP already points at http://ollama:11434.
steps.human_prompt: Download the Ollama image and the nomic-embed-text model (several GB) and start an Ollama container? (yes/no)

verify.run: docker compose exec -T ollama ollama list

diagnosis: Pull failed: docker compose logs ollama-pull.
Search still errors: docker compose exec -T mcp node -e "fetch('http://ollama:11434/api/tags').then(r=>r.text()).then(console.log)"
on_failure.rollback: Set COMPOSE_PROFILES= (empty) in .env, then docker compose --profile search stop ollama && docker compose --profile search rm -f ollama ollama-pull (the ollama model volume is kept).

steps.title: Register the MCP in Claude Code and print the client JSON
steps.why: Adds a user-scope Claude Code server (default name ygg-business-docker) and registers with installed AI clients.

diagnosis: 'already has a server named': choose another YGG_CLIENT_NAME; never remove the operator's existing one.
'Failed to connect': stack not running (docker compose ps) or docker not on the PATH given to the client.

steps.title: Automated NocoDB base, source, and vector index configuration
steps.why: Automates creating the Business Platform base, attaching Postgres data sources (public and mcp schemas), seeding demo inventory, and warming nomic-embed-text vector embeddings.

diagnosis: Not 200: docker compose logs nocodb | tail -50 (it takes ~30 s on first boot).
on_failure.rollback: Delete the base in the NocoDB UI (does not touch Postgres data).

steps.title: OPTIONAL: host-level receipts hooks (zsh + Claude Code)
steps.why: Logs every AI shell command / file write on this machine into ygg_receipts.mac.receipts. Edits ~/.zshenv and ~/.claude/settings.json (backed up first). Needs Node >= 22 on the host and a host build of the repo.
steps.human_prompt: Install receipts hooks into ~/.zshenv and ~/.claude/settings.json (backups made first)? (yes/no)
steps.run: npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build && deploy/host-receipts/install.sh

diagnosis: 'already exists; left unchanged': a receipts hook (e.g. the ygg-scratch one) is already installed; that is fine.
New shells print errors: restore the .bak-<timestamp> copies immediately.

post_install_verification.title: pg, nocodb, mcp running; pg and mcp healthy

expect.output_matches: mcp running healthy[\s\S]*nocodb running[\s\S]*pg running healthy

post_install_verification.title: tools/list shows the 6 tools over stdio and HTTP
post_install_verification.run: docker compose exec -T mcp node scripts/mcp-check.mjs

post_install_verification.title: Streamable HTTP reachable from the host on 127.0.0.1 only
post_install_verification.run: P=$(sed -n 's/^YGG_MCP_HTTP_PORT=//p' .env); curl -sS -m 10 -X POST http://127.0.0.1:$P/mcp -H 'content-type: application/json' -H 'accept: application/json, text/event-stream' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/list"}' | grep -o '"name":"business_[a-z_]*"' | sort -u | wc -l | tr -d ' '; docker compose port mcp 8787

post_install_verification.title: Evals runner works (SQL answer key and MCP tools agree on all 10 questions)
post_install_verification.run: docker compose exec -T mcp node scripts/run-evals.mjs --agree
post_install_verification.note: On an empty or demo DB the answers differ from the operator's real-data answer key, so --agree checks SQL vs tools. With real data restored, run without --agree: expect '10/10 evals passed'.

post_install_verification.title: Empty by default (skip if demo or real data was loaded on purpose)
post_install_verification.run: docker compose exec -T pg psql -X -At -U ygg_read -d ygg_business -c 'select count(*) from public."Business"'

post_install_verification.title: .env and dumps are ignored by git and docker
post_install_verification.run: git check-ignore -q .env && grep -q '^\*\*/\.env$' .dockerignore && test -z "$(git ls-files | grep -E '(^|/)\.env$|\.dump$')" && echo clean

post_install_verification.title: Offline unit tests (needs Node >= 22 on the host)
post_install_verification.run: npm ci --no-audit --no-fund >/dev/null && npx vitest run test/core && node --test hooks/mac-receipts/classify.test.mjs

post_install_verification.title: the operator signs off
post_install_verification.human_prompt: The checks above passed. Do you accept this install? (yes/no)

uninstall.title: Remove the Claude Code registration this guide added
uninstall.note: Only the name added in s12. Never remove ygg-business. Remove the Claude Desktop entry by hand.

uninstall.title: Remove host receipts hooks (if s14 ran)
Stop and remove containers, KEEP data volumes and .env
uninstall.note: ./install.sh brings everything back with the same data.

uninstall.title: DESTRUCTIVE: also delete volumes (database, NocoDB, models), the image and .env
uninstall.note: Irreversible. Equivalent: docker compose -p $COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME --profile search down -v. Never use another project name.

uninstall.title: Remove the checkout
uninstall.note: Only after u4, and only the directory created in s01.
